import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead sase-16n.11.7.1 (core-accept) is complete and closed. All work landed in the linked sase-core checkout (12 files); the host finalizer will commit it — final declaration accepted.

What changed:

- Accept no longer joins lines (`project_tag/accept.rs`): the ref regex now captures the ref itself in group 1, so deletion ends at the ref like the Python guard's span; orphan collapsing eats only horizontal whitespace; a ref alone on its line removes that line without joining neighbors. Rejected glued matches resume at the next byte via `captures_at` instead of skipping the whole match.
- Pre-v5 LSP fallback (`server/completion.rs`): empty `project_tags` falls back to entry-derived targets via the new `vcs_project_entry_targets`; deleted the test-only `build_vcs_project_completion_candidates` (confirmed no sase_core_py binding and no sase Python callers) and migrated its tests to a local wrapper documenting the fallback contract.
- Cleanups: corrected the stale "line starts" accept doc, removed the dead `sibling_names` check, derived the catalog version bound from `VCS_PROJECT_CATALOG_SCHEMA_VERSION`.
- macOS test: case-variant collision test now builds records directly instead of creating `alpha`/`ALPHA` directories, so it runs on case-insensitive filesystems.

Verification: new vectors for all three plan inputs plus the lone-line and glued-match cases; new LSP fallback test asserting the other tag is deleted from a tagless v4 catalog. Focused suites green (project_tag 25, collisions 3, vcs_project 15, LSP vcs_completion 16). `sase tool run check` succeeded — 35 ok suites, 0 failures. One transient lib failure on the first gate run passed standalone (3321) and on the full re-run; no epic-symbol entries remained.
